newsitem.title: UK: Harman wins re-election to UK Labour's top council.
newsitem.headline: Harman wins re-election to UK Labour's top council.

text.p: Harriet Harman, a close ally of British Labour leader Tony Blair, won re-election to the party's National Executive Committee on Monday.

The vote was a symbolic victory for the modernising wing of the Labour party. Labour traditionalists were outraged at the start of the year when Harman, now the party's health spokeswoman, decided to send her son to a selective grammar school in defiance of party policy.

All seven members of parliament who stood for re-election to the NEC as representatives of Constituency Labour Parties were successful. Foreign affairs spokesman Robin Cook topped the postal ballot for the second year running.
The results were announced at the end of the first day of Labour's annual conference.
